lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 这个十块钱。那个二十块。
lines.pinyin: Zhège shí kuài qián. Nàge èrshí kuài.
lines.english: This is 10 yuan. That one is 20 yuan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 太贵了。便宜一点可以吗？
lines.pinyin: Tài guì le. Piányi yīdiǎn kěyǐ ma?
lines.english: Too expensive. Can it be a little cheaper?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Zhège bā kuài, nàge shíwǔ kuài.
lines.english: This one 8 yuan, that one 15 yuan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 好，我买这个和那个。一共多少？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ mǎi zhège hé nàge. Yīgòng duōshao?
lines.english: OK, I'll buy this and that. How much in total?

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Gěi nǐ sānshí kuài. Zhǎo qī kuài.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you, welcome back next time!
